name: Harness on steroids
personality: willing to replace mechanisms that do not earn their complexity
audience_feeling: The reader should understand that the project learns control behavior from rich Work/Codex evidence, tests it rapidly across different harnesses and models, and distinguishes shipped evidence from the next measured experiment.
promise: Make agent behavior observable, transfer the useful control patterns through small measurable interventions, and keep process, output, continuity, variance, and verified outcome visible.

preferred_terms.research: what the local corpus and experiments show
preferred_terms.technical detail: explain the reason before the mechanism
preferred_terms.iteration: one hypothesis, smallest intervention, measured rerun
preferred_terms.status: shipped, experimentally supported, planned, or unknown
